subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
topic: Methods and applications of electrical temperature indicating systems
syllabus_extract: Methods and applications of electrical temperature indicating systems
specific_objectives: 15.1.5.1 Trainee will be able to explain various method of temperature indication system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of RTD and Thermocouple probe installation; Safety: High voltage precautions; Supervision: Instructor monitors connections and probe handling.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a temperature indicating system?
Name two common types of electrical temperature sensors used in aircraft.
Why is accurate temperature monitoring critical for engine performance?

development.content:
Resistance Temperature Detector (RTD) principles
Thermocouple operation and Seebeck effect
Thermistor characteristics and applications
Signal conditioning and transmission methods

topics: Comparison of RTD, Thermocouple, and Thermistor
Typical aircraft applications for each sensor type
development.content:
Comparison of RTD, Thermocouple, and Thermistor

Calibration and maintenance requirements
Fault detection and troubleshooting indicators

topics: Data logging and remote indication techniques
Impact of electrical noise on sensor accuracy
Future trends in digital temperature sensing
development.content:
Integration with aircraft warning systems
Data logging and remote indication techniques
Impact of electrical noise on sensor accuracy
Future trends in digital temperature sensing

summary_questions: Explain the difference in output signal between an RTD and a thermocouple.
Describe a scenario where a thermocouple would be preferred over an RTD in an aircraft engine.
How does electrical noise affect the accuracy of a temperature indicating system?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the Ratio meter system and thermoelectric thermometers to be discussed in Lesson Plan 12.
